flags: IDENTITY / DOMAIN CONFLATION (critical): The directory lists this tool as ImgCreator by ZMO.AI, whose actual product is served from imgcreator.zmo.ai (parent site zmo.ai). The vendor's standalone domain imgcreator.ai is under construction. A prior draft gathered its privacy policy, terms, content-license quote, and 'Sacramento / ImgCreator Limited (California)' details from imgcreatorai.io, a separate same-name domain that identifies only as 'ImgCreator AI' with no stated ZMO.AI affiliation. Those facts have been stripped because they cannot be attributed to this vendor. The correct vendor's own policy/terms could not be verified.

AI training posture could not be verified on the vendor's own domain. The 'for improving our services' license language cited in an earlier draft came from the unaffiliated same-name domain imgcreatorai.io, not from ZMO.AI, and has been removed. No opt-out mechanism was located on the vendor's own domain.
No trust center, security page, or formal compliance documentation on vendor domain. Only basic privacy policy and terms of service available.
No SOC 2, ISO 27001, or equivalent enterprise security certifications found. Consistent with startup/growth-stage product but limits enterprise adoption.
Data residency: no documented control over where user data is processed or stored. US company with no explicit GDPR DPA or EU data handling commitments.
Breach notification and incident response procedures not publicly documented.
Third-party integrations / sub-processors: privacy policy mentions 'service providers' without transparent list.
Website status (under construction) raises questions about company focus and maintenance cadence.

No verified legal entity for the vendor could be located. 'ImgCreator Limited' and a Sacramento/California headquarters named in an earlier draft are unsupported by any located source (they did not appear on imgcreatorai.io either) and have been removed as likely fabricated or borrowed from an unrelated entity.
